subject: Banking
title: Barings Bank: The Rogue Trader
description: A short lesson to help you apply Barings Bank: The Rogue Trader.

hook.text: Nick Leeson was a 28-year-old trader who single-handedly destroyed Britain's oldest merchant bank. Barings fell in 1995.

buildup.text: Leeson was supposed to make safe arbitrage trades in Singapore. Instead he made massive bets on Japanese stock futures.

discovery.text: He hid losses in a secret account numbered 88888. By the time anyone found out, losses exceeded $1.3 billion.

twist.text: Barings had survived 233 years, financed wars, and served the Queen. One trader in a back office wiped it all out.

climax.text: Barings' failure proved that internal controls matter more than reputation.

punchline.text: 233-year-old bank. One rogue trader. $1.3 billion in hidden losses. Gone.

quiz.question: How did Nick Leeson hide his trading losses?
